CA.rationale: No attention/processing condition linked to content organization is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified with coordinate lists and an explicit origin/status field for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colors and coordinate sets for named referents at current time.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields separately attribute provenance/estimate status to identified contents.

O.rationale: Coordinate lists and explicit origin metadata describe how content is represented and organized for the referents.
